item.title: ClipFlair receives nomination for UN-based Award in Sri Lanka!
item.dc:creator: admin
item.description:
ClipFlair is one of almost 500 nominees to be examined by an international Grand Jury in the city of Tallinn/Estonia. Patra, August 08, 2013 ClipFlair, funded by the European Commission (EACEA, LLP-KA2) is nominated by an international jury of ICT experts to enter the next round of the 2013 World Summit Award (WSA) in e-Learning & Science. ClipFlair will compete against almost 500 outstanding e-Content products and applications from 168 countries in front of the WSA’s Grand Jury from Aug. 29 to Aug. 31 in Estonia’s capital city, Tallinn.
